prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Will I have to pay a late fee if I return this book on Thursday?
spokenPromptZh: 如果我星期四還這本書，要付逾期費嗎？

options.text: The return slot is next to the side door.
options.whyZh: 回答了去哪裡還書，卻沒說明會不會逾期。

options.text: No, the book isn't due until Friday.
options.zh: 不會，這本書到星期五才到期。
options.whyZh: 還書期限是星期五，星期四還書不會逾期，因此不必付逾期費。

options.text: You can check out up to six books at a time.
options.zh: 你一次最多可以借六本書。
options.whyZh: 借閱上限和這本書星期四歸還是否逾期無關。

explanationZh: 還書期限是星期五，星期四還書不會逾期，因此不必付逾期費。

vocabulary.note: 超過借閱期限才可能收取的費用。
此片語在 isn't due until Friday 中表示星期四還來得及。

evidence: Will I have to pay a late fee if I return this book on Thursday? / No, the book isn't due until Friday.
